title: Chapter 24
text: ∫ Butch Van Gogh just before leaving Hollywood my cat got into a fight leaving him with a cauliflower ear. now in this new place I took him to a vet yesterday. they had animal dentistry shrinks for animals plus an EMERGENCY room he had to have surgery anesthesia pills ointments. the bill came to $82.50. “Jesus,” I told the vet, “this is a ten-year-old de-balled alley cat. I can get a dozen of these for nothing.” the vet just made little circles on a piece of paper with his pencil. “all right,” I said, “go ahead.” “Butch Bukowski,” the vet wrote down the patient’s name. when I went back to get him they had his skull wrapped and he looked like he had a hole drilled in his head. he was carried out of room 6 by a nurse. “what’d you do?” I asked, “give him a lobotomy?” now he just sits on top of the stove and stares at me. Butch Van Gogh Artaud Bukowski. like a friend of mine once told me: “man, everything you touch turns to shit!” he’s right. I’ve been masturbating since I was eleven years old.
